categories.main_business_segments: China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited operates primarily in the manufacturing, sales, and distribution of alcoholic beverages, focusing on beer and baijiu. The Group has developed a unique dual empowerment business model combining beer and baijiu segments, with beer as the core and baijiu as a growing complementary segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced brewing technologies and intelligent manufacturing, including new smart factories and digital transformation initiatives. It emphasizes technological innovation, digital marketing integration, and sustainable production methods, including carbon-neutral certifications and green manufacturing practices. The company also invests in R&D for new product development and low-carbon brewing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include consumers of premium and mid-end beer and baijiu products in China, with expanding presence in emerging channels such as online retail and instant delivery. The Group also targets international markets, particularly Southeast Asia and parts of Europe, leveraging Hong Kong and Macau as strategic hubs. Key markets include domestic Chinese provinces and overseas regions with growing demand for premium alcoholic beverages.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across Mainland China with 62 breweries in 25 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It also has significant operations and market presence in Hong Kong, Macau, Southeast Asia, and selected European markets. The company uses Hong Kong as its registered office and principal place of business.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Resources Beer operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the alcoholic beverage supply chain, focusing on production, sales, and distribution. It actively manages upstream supply chain elements, such as domestic barley cultivation and supplier partnerships, to ensure supply chain sovereignty and sustainability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus includes premiumisation of products, dual empowerment of beer and baijiu businesses, digital transformation, and sustainability initiatives. R&D priorities involve developing new high-quality and niche products, advancing low-carbon brewing technologies, and enhancing supply chain sustainability, particularly through domestic barley revitalization and carbon footprint management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of beer and baijiu at various price points, including premium and mid-end segments. The company also leverages online platforms and emerging retail channels to increase sales volume and market penetration. Licensing or subscription models are not indicated; revenue is recognized at point of sale.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Resources Beer is a leading player in the Chinese beer industry and is recognized as a market leader in premium beer segments. It competes with other major domestic and international alcoholic beverage companies, leveraging its dual beer and baijiu business model and strong brand portfolio including Heineken®, Snow Beer, and Jinsha. The Group is positioned as a pioneer in premiumisation and sustainability within the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The Group reported a turnover of approximately RMB38.6 billion in 2024, with a profit attributable to shareholders of RMB4.74 billion. It has demonstrated steady growth over recent years, with premium beer sales volume increasing significantly and EBITDA rising. The company maintains a strong net cash position and has shown resilience despite market fluctuations, with a focus on high-quality development and premiumisation driving growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Resources Beer emphasizes high-quality, premium alcoholic beverages with a diversified product portfolio combining domestic and international brands. Its unique dual empowerment model integrates beer and baijiu businesses, offering consumers innovative and personalized products. The Group differentiates itself through technological innovation, sustainability leadership, digital transformation, and strong brand equity, aiming to provide superior product quality and consumer experience.
